do.rule: Keep human characters sized to roughly half the vertical 9:16 frame height in indoor/patio scenes rather than shrinking them to fit oversized background furniture.
When the script specifically mentions an action and prop like dumping into a sink ('pileta'), render the sink and pouring motion rather than placing an abstract red X over a generic pose.
Ensure character hands clearly clasp the gourd contour rather than floating as simple discs.
Model featured prop assets with recognizable silhouettes instead of basic geometric primitives.
Ensure featured material types are directly depicted rather than abstracted as numbered cards.
Keep graphic text centered and safely within vertical UI margins.
Keep all props such as gourds, bombillas, and thermoses correctly proportioned relative to the figures holding them.

avoid.rule: Never render handheld props (mate, flasks, cups) without attaching an arm and curling hand explicitly grasping them.
Do not render callout pill badges pointing to a prop when the main headline already states the exact same phrase.
Avoid duplicating large focal props like parrillas or hearths within the same backdrop.
Avoid placing headline text boxes across character eye lines in close-ups.
Avoid placing isolated, shrunken full-body figures in oversized empty rooms.
Avoid T-pose or wide floating hand placements when characters hold no props.
Avoid reusing the exact same static close-up frame multiple times consecutively without a change in expression, angle, or action.
Avoid using board templates that display only plain text without any visual icons, props, or characters.
